title: C¹ radial cut-off across a thin annulus with gradient O(1/δ)
statement: There is a constant C₀ > 0 such that, for every P ∈ ℕ, every y ∈ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) and all ρ > 0, δ > 0, there is ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ with all of the following properties: ζ is C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1); ζ has compact support; tsupport ζ ⊆ B̄_{ρ+δ}(y); 0 ≤ ζ(z) ≤ 1 for all z; ζ(z) = 1 for z ∈ B̄_ρ(y); ‖Dζ(z)‖ ≤ C₀/δ for all z (operator norm of fderiv ℝ ζ z); and Dζ(z) = 0 for every z ∉ B_{ρ+δ}(y) ∖ B̄_ρ(y).
lean_statement: ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (y : Euclid P) (ρ δ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ∃ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ HasCompactSupport ζ ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ closedBall y (ρ + δ) ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z ∧ ζ z ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ z ∈ closedBall y ρ, ζ z = 1) ∧ (∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖ ≤ C₀ / δ) ∧ ∀ z, z ∉ ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ → fderiv ℝ ζ z = 0
